description: Preflights a pinned Overture release and publishes privacy-minimized U.S. place candidates with address latitude/longitude only; remote extraction is blocked unless separately and explicitly authorized.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects. Accept only exact HTTPS Overture STAC paths and immutable release-scoped AWS GeoParquet asset paths discovered from the pinned collection.
retry: Retry transient STAC metadata requests with bounded backoff. Each managed recovery attempt requires fresh explicit authorization and the stopped operation ID. Release or asset identity drift fails before further ranges are read.
checkpoint: Pin the STAC release, ordered asset URLs, and runtime manifest. Record each asset's strong ETag and length before reading ranges. Checkpoint only a verified privacy-minimized U.S. output with its source identity and journal hash. Recovery reuses verified completed assets and shares cumulative reservations across attempts.
idempotency: The pinned metadata and runtime manifests, ordered asset identities, extraction fingerprint, and verified checkpoint and final output hashes bind the selected snapshot.
cancellation: Abort STAC requests or interrupt DuckDB, close gzip streams, leave the previous current pointer unchanged, and retain no promoted partial release.
retention_profile: Retain pinned STAC metadata, privacy-minimized U.S. per-asset checkpoints and selected source snapshots, governed normalized releases, and checksums. Global GeoParquet assets stay remote.
